description: Find a UK Parliament committee by name and get its id, house, type, parent committee, current sub-committees and contact email and address. This is the first step for the other committee tools and answers "which committee covers X" and "how do I contact it". Source: UK Parliament Committees API. Searches committee names only, not inquiry topics. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, words from the committee name, e.g. "treasury"

take.description: integer, optional, how many committees to return (1-50), default 10

name: committee_search
